purpose: External dataset check. Assembly101 primary reversal coverage was too small after holding out both subjects and toys. HoloAssist is a separately collected set of egocentric tasks, with a different annotation team and different activity taxonomy. Only released train/validation event annotations are used. At freeze only documentation, headers and one schema record were inspected. No HoloAssist aggregate, model or task outcomes seen.
units: One physical video_name. Collapse byte-for-byte identical evaluation streams for a duplicate name, reject inconsistent duplicates entirely. Use an exact normalized taskType within which to pair recordings, lowercase and collapse whitespace, no synonym maps. Valid fine action and coarse role are each an ordered pair of structured Verb and Noun attributes; drop missing, blank, none, n/a or unknown tokens and zero/negative durations. Do not read action sentences, correctness fields, narration or conversations into scoring. Require strict containment in one and only one coarse interval when constructing reference marks. At prediction time use every positive-duration fine action with valid verb/noun, including outside coarse intervals. Duplicate fine records with identical start,end,verb,noun count once.
pairing: Within each task type sort distinct recording names by SHA256 of holoassist-event-v1|name. Take up to the first 40 records in each group, pair adjacent records without replacement (at most 20 nonoverlapping pairs per activity type). If the count is odd drop the last unpaired record. No pair selection or replacement based on roles. New collection is disjoint from Assembly101; release metadata here does not verify that different recordings within a pair have different people.
eligible_labels: Require the same fine verb/noun under at least two distinct coarse verb/noun roles within each recording. A transferable role must occur once for this fine action in both recordings. Reuse all unique shared roles. Paired swaps require two distinct such roles for the same fine action; strict order reversals must be temporally separated (positive gap) in each recording. Both transfer directions.
comparison: Keep other-part context, forced prefix+suffix edit alignment, and uniform ranking identical to the Assembly101 experiment. Both source and target get complete human action transcripts; inputs never include coarse roles or device/task labels as matching features. No fitting, tuning, alternate matching of words or trial selection.
primary: Equal task-type mean gain of other-part context over edit for BOTH correctly localized cues on strict reversals; paired cluster bootstrap over activity types, 10000 draws random.Random(20261120). Require at least 8 contributing activity types and 20 physical recording pairs exhibiting reversals, gain >=10 percentage points and lower 95% endpoint >0. If insufficient, report the attempted denominator and inconclusive primary. Secondary single and same-order scores describe the fixed set. Do not interpret as online or visual execution.
budget: At most 130 MiB source annotations, no media. Stream parsing; count eligibility before performance. Matching is deterministic symbolic analysis. No local model, accelerator, parameter tuning, or paid resource.
